metadata.title: COBOL Programming Language Knowledge Graph
metadata.subject: Detailed graph of COBOL language constructs, standards, data representation, control flow, files, enterprise integrations, runtime, testing, security, operations and modernization.

source_basis.primary: Curated technical synthesis of COBOL language concepts, common compiler documentation, mainframe ecosystem concepts and software-engineering practices.
source_basis.verification_note: This graph is a broad reference, not a substitute for the normative COBOL standard or a selected compiler's manuals. Feature availability and behavior vary by standard edition, dialect, platform and compiler options.
source_basis.scope: History and standards; compiler ecosystem; source format; divisions; data declarations; numeric and character representation; statements; control flow; files; databases; transaction monitors; interoperability; runtime; security; testing; operations; modernization.

metadata.relationship_direction: Relationships are directed from source to target; the type and description define the meaning.
metadata.identifier_conventions: Entity IDs are lowercase snake_case slugs. Relationship IDs are sequential rel_NNNNN identifiers.
